package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/endpoint"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/api/output"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/auth"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/web"
)

type row struct{ Value int64 }
type other struct{ Value int64 }

var invalid = endpoint.Config[row, string]{Handle: func(*web.Request, auth.Principal, other) (output.Prepared[string], error) {
	return output.Prepared[string]{}, nil
}}
